name: Blackdrop
author: Scott Angel
description: Classic Winamp visualization nostalgia for Omarchy: fullscreen, music-reactive motion with 12 presets. Left/Right switches presets, Up saves one, Down gives Random per song. Blackdrop covers the bar and inhibits idle, so the display and its audio stay alive; silence becomes OLED-friendly true black with a drifting neon Omarchy mark. Installed from the marketplace it shows a setup card that finishes the one-time projectM packages and its reversible configuration in one visible step.
